limitations: A source-calendar span is not network live time. True exposure/selection-normalized rates remain OPEN.
The rare definition SNR>=78 is a metadata proxy; it does not guarantee GW250114 damping precision or posterior width.
The 31 calibration products span older runs and O4. Calling this mixture pure O4 would be inaccurate.
No physical sigma significance or 5sigma reach follows with the systematic gate red. Numbers are prospective scaling diagnostics.
O5 is phased and historical range ratios are not a guaranteed sensitivity at its start.
